Exercise: Press Sit-Up

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
expert

Movement Patterns:

- horizontal_flexion
- vertical_push

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:

- chest
- shoulders
- triceps

Equipment:

- barbell

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- core_strength_and_stability
- upper_body_strength

Contraindications:

- Shoulder injuries
- Lower back pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: Kettlebell Press Sit-Up, equipment: kettlebell
- name: Dumbbell Press Sit-Up, equipment: dumbbells

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Barbell Upright Row, equipment: barbell
- exercise_name: Overhead Press, equipment: dumbbells or barbell

Instructions:

- To begin, lie down on a bench with a barbell resting on your chest. Position your legs so they are secure on the extension of the abdominal bench. This is the starting position.
- While inhaling, tighten your abdominals and glutes. Simultaneously curl your torso as you do when performing a sit-up and press the barbell to an overhead position while exhaling. Tip: Use your arms to push the barbell out as you perform this exercise while still focusing on the abdominal muscles.
- Lower your upper body back down to the starting position while bringing the barbell back down to your torso. Remember to breathe in while lowering the body.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
